## Triage: first touch → `domain:server` · `lease:A2` · **p1** · `security` · 2026-11-15T12:47Z

⛔ Not a claim.

A permission set's own `readable: false` field row must win over that same set's View All vote. Today the View All vote exposes a field the set explicitly hides, which is a field-level security boundary (#32997 rule 4), so **p1** (pre-graded). Ruled A (platform) per the card. The ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ amendment is governed and rides in the same PR or a spec/skills card; the gate change is plugin-security (A2). ⛔ Discuss the mechanism only through `security-findings.md` channels from here.

Claim amendment · #33828 · pre-claim check recorded after the fact · 2026-11-15T13:55Z

Pre-claim lane: server because the fix is in `packages/core/src/security/**`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/**` and `packages/lint/**`; the ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ amendment the card asks for rides in the same PR as governed text, so the seat lands it with the maintainer (seat routing ruling, this thread).
Pre-claim deps: none (no Blocked-by; hotcrm#2481 waits on this card, not the reverse).
Prior rulings read: ADR-0066 D2 ⑧ note of 2026-11-02 (ruling of record 6573563853, letter A) states the opposite for both bits ("a set can no longer withhold a field from its own View All / Modify All holders"); the card's ruling A amends it by name for View All only, so the build follows the card for View All and leaves the Modify All vote as it is today. Modify All goes to the seat as a separate decision. Pins that assert today's answer and will flip for View All, inside the ruling: `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.test.ts` (the inert-mask rule), `packages/cli/test/superuser-bypass-mirror-parity.test.ts`, `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/explain-engine.test.ts`.

domain:server#5 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jVPGBoi3MCGoKbW1Hv

Claim amendment 2 · #33828 · after contract review 6900701652 · 2026-11-15T22:03Z

The declaration lines change. The exported field-vote helper gains an optional parameter, which grows the public surface. The meaning of a set's own field-mask row changes, so the kind is semantic.
Clause-②: yes (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: semantic

The file surface adds two places. First, one ADR-0087 semantic migration entry, a new file under `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/`. Second, one card-named door-level pin file under `packages/qa/dogfood/`. Before the push, merge-tree runs against every open PR that touches either place.
The PR closes this card in part, with `Part of #33828`. The Modify All half stays open under the seat's ruling. Modify All itself stays as today.
